messages:
maria: seeing a spike of 502s from eastus6 gpu pool, lots of pod connection resets. services/gpu-inference reporting incomplete responses :warning:
aj: grafana shows conntrack table at 96% across eastus6-gpu-nodes :eyes:
infra-bot: conntrack_usage{region="eastus6",pool="gpu"}=0.96
cheng: kube-proxy logs show repeated 'nf_conntrack: table full' warnings — grabbing logs now
sam: can we confirm ip_local_port_range and ephemeral ports? also any recent network changes?
maria: we did a calico roll yesterday (vxlan mtu changed to 1450) but RDMA nodes still on 9000 MTU, possible fragmentation => conn entries stuck
aj: running quick checks on one node:
```
$ ss -s
TCP:   12345 (estab 9876, closed 234, orphaned 0, timewait 4321)
Transport Total:
  TCP: 9876
  UDP: 432
``` 
aj: /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max = 262144
cheng: kube-proxy message: 'nf_conntrack: expect new entry, but table full' — looks like lots of short-lived SNAT churn from east-west gRPC flows
sam: check ip_local_port_range and conntrack timeouts:
```
$ cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
32768	61000
$ sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established = 432000
```
maria: proposal: roll a DS to bump nf_conntrack_max to 1M on affected nodes and tune tcp timeout down to 7d->3d, then restart kube-proxy to flush nat entries
aj: also recommend decreasing mtu mismatch — revert calico change for RDMA nodes or unify mtu; fragmentation seems to prevent FIN/ACKs from tearing down conntrack
cheng: creating a quick daemonset with sysctl settings and a job to run `conntrack -L | wc -l` pre/post
sam: applied DS to 188 nodes in eastus6 (sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=1048576, nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=259200)
oncall-bot: alert cleared: conntrack_usage eastus6 -> 0.42
maria: post-patch metrics look much better, latency drops and fewer 502s, but saw a small window of pod restarts during the change
aj: follow-up: open infra task to enforce mtu parity in calico config for any RDMA-enabled node types and add an e2e that runs a conntrack health check under load
cheng: also adding exporter + alert rule at 70% table usage and an automation to increase nf_conntrack_max proportionally when under sustained pressure
sam: filed INFRA-6123 for the calico/mtu rollback + tests
maria: thanks everyone, keeping monitoring on for next 6 hours :thumbsup:
